title.rendered: October 2025 Morning Prayer — A Powerful Declaration for the New Month

excerpt.rendered: Start October 2025 with faith — a powerful morning prayer and declaration to set the tone for a month of breakthrough, blessing, and divine favour.

content.rendered:
Greetings on the arrival of October

2025

Father in heaven,

This morning, I am filled with gratitude, thanking You for giving me a fresh month and a new day. Thank you, Lord, for guiding me through the past. I now stand on the precipice of new beginnings. I honor You for Your faithfulness, Your protection, and Your unending love.

This is the Lord’s doing and it is marvelous in our eyes. Psalms 118:23

Heavenly Father,
I am so grateful that You have given me a new month of october and a new day this morning. I stand on the threshold of fresh starts, and I am grateful to the Lord for guiding me through the past. I praise You for Your loyalty, Your guardianship, and Your unwavering love.

Lord, grant me peace, happiness, health, opportunities, and immeasurable blessings this month. Take away all of my doubts, anxieties, and fears and replace them with courage, hope, and faith. Allow Your light to shine in my life so that I can serve as a conduit for others to see Your goodness.

Bless my community, family, and loved ones. By Your grace, keep us strong, safe, and united. I pray that this month of October will bring more testimonies, discoveries, and prayers answered.

Knowing that You have control over my future, Father, I face this month with assurance. Let Your will be done in my life, lead me, and guide me.

My prayer is in the powerful name of Jesus.

Amen
& Amen. 🙏🏽
